findings.finding: The claimed real dispatcher proof is still controlled: publication.extract_fields is monkeypatched to prepared.fields. No production fields.py/source-adapter hook calls this parser, so the actual _revalidate path remains unproven and prior generic extraction still blocks strong binding.
findings.required_fix: Register the source-specific dispatch in the normal fields/publication path and rerun _revalidate without monkeypatching extract_fields; prove the same eligible/blocked result and zero persistence.

findings.finding: Artifact URL validation is only substring '/681/' plus '.pdf'; it does not enforce the preserved official host/URL or content type. The parser also relies on run.artifact.byte_len rather than a pinned expected byte length.
findings.required_fix: Pin the exact approved document URL/host and expected byte length (or prove the equivalent canonical artifact receipt) before field promotion.
